claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament features a $22.5 million total purse.
Rory McIlroy is the winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $4,500,000.
The 2026 Masters Tournament purse is the highest in Masters history.
The runner-up of the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $2,430,000.
Third place in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $1,530,000.
Fourth place in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $1,080,000.
Fifth place in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $900,000.
Professionals who miss the 36-hole cut in the 2026 Masters Tournament receive $25,000.
The 2026 Masters Tournament purse increased to $22.5 million from $21.5 million in 2025.
The 2026 Masters Tournament is the highest-paying event among golf's four majors.
The top four finishers in the 2026 Masters Tournament all earn over $1 million.
Amateur players do not receive prize money in the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The $4.5 million winner's check at the 2026 Masters Tournament matches the highest on the PGA Tour.
The Players Championship offers a $4.5 million winner's check.
